items.problem: The spec does not set which result `send_mail` returns when one input meets several results: an `INVALID_INPUT` condition (mailbox.md:79), `ALREADY_SENT` (an existing `mailbox_once_key` row) and the throw for a content `once_key` with the core prefix of `item-ledger` (mailbox.md:71). e.g. `send_mail` with `once_key` `gift`, after a mail with `once_key` `gift` was sent, and with `expire_ms` above `mailbox.maxExpireMs`, returns either `ALREADY_SENT` with the existing mail ID or `INVALID_INPUT`. `admin-api` answers 200 or 400 (admin-api.md:192), and `ranking` counts the first as success and turns the second into `REJECTED` (ranking.md:165). Before the diff, the existing conditions (e.g. `template_id` not in the table, or `expire_ms` above `mailbox.maxExpireMs`) already had this gap
